lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag ghat mahi doojee aan ||
lines.translation: Know that as long as you place your hopes in others,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਲਉ ਮਹਲਿ ਨ ਲਾਭੈ ਜਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau lau mahal na laabhai jaan ||
lines.translation: you shall not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ramat raam siu laago ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: When you embrace love for the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਬ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅੰਗ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer tab niramal a(n)g ||8||1||
lines.translation: says Kabeer, then, you shall become pure in your very fiber. ||8||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee chetee baanee naamadeu jeeu kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Chaytee, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਾ ਪਾਹਨ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaa paahan taareeale ||
lines.translation: God makes even stones float.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਜਨ ਕਸ ਨ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam kahat jan kas na tare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: So why shouldn't Your humble slave also float across, chanting Your Name, O Lord? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਰੀਲੇ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੂਪ ਕੁਬਿਜਾ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taareele ganikaa bin roop kubijaa biaadh ajaamal taareeale ||
lines.translation: You saved the prostitute, and the ugly hunch-back; You helped the hunter and Ajaamal swim across as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਬਧਿਕ ਜਨ ਤੇਊ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan badhik jan teoo mukat bhae ||
lines.translation: The hunter who shot Krishna in the foot - even he was liberated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hau bal bal jin raam kahe ||1||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who chant the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਦੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: daasee sut jan bidar sudaamaa ugrasain kau raaj deee ||
lines.translation: You saved Bidur, the son of the slave-girl, and Sudama; You restored Ugrasain to his throne.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਹੀਨ ਤਪ ਹੀਨ ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੀਨ ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਊ ਤਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jap heen tap heen kul heen kram heen naame ke suaamee teoo tare ||2||1||
lines.translation: Without meditation, without penance, without a good family, without good deeds, Naam Dayv's Lord and Master saved them all. ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee ravidaas jee ke pade gauRee guaareree ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree, Padhay Of Ravi Daas Jee, Gauree Gwaarayree:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੋਚ ਸੋਚ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree sa(n)gat poch soch din raatee ||
lines.translation: The company I keep is wretched and low, and I am anxious day and night;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਕੁਭਾਂਤੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: meraa karam kutilataa janam kubhaa(n)tee ||1||
lines.translation: my actions are crooked, and I am of lowly birth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਸਈਆ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam gusaeeaa jee ke jeevanaa ||
lines.translation: O Lord, Master of the earth, Life of the soul,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi na bisaarahu mai jan teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: please do not forget me! I am Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਹੁ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree harahu bipat jan karahu subhaaee ||
lines.translation: Take away my pains, and bless Your humble servant with Your Sublime Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਨ ਛਾਡਉ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਲ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: charan na chhaadau sareer kal jaaee ||2||
lines.translation: I shall not leave Your Feet, even though my body may perish. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਪਰਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਭਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu ravidaas parau teree saabhaa ||
lines.translation: Says Ravi Daas, I seek the protection of Your Sanctuary;

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਲਾਂਬਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: beg milahu jan kar na bilaa(n)baa ||3||1||
lines.translation: please, meet Your humble servant - do not delay! ||3||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਗਮ ਪੁਰਾ ਸਹਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: begam puraa sahar ko naau ||
lines.translation: Baygumpura, 'the city without sorrow', is the name of the town.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਦੋਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh a(n)dohu nahee tihi thaau ||
lines.translation: There is no suffering or anxiety there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਂ ਤਸਵੀਸ ਖਿਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa(n) tasavees khiraaj na maal ||
lines.translation: There are no troubles or taxes on commodities there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਉਫੁ ਨ ਖਤਾ ਨ ਤਰਸੁ ਜਵਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khauph na khataa na taras javaal ||1||
lines.translation: There is no fear, blemish or downfall there. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੂਬ ਵਤਨ ਗਹ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab mohi khoob vatan gah paaee ||
lines.translation: Now, I have found this most excellent city.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਹਾਂ ਖੈਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: oohaa(n) khair sadaa mere bhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: There is lasting peace and safety there, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਮੁ ਦਾਇਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaim daaim sadaa paatisaahee ||
lines.translation: God's Kingdom is steady, stable and eternal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ ਏਕ ਸੋ ਆਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dom na sem ek so aahee ||
lines.translation: There is no second or third status; all are equal there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਬਾਦਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਸਹੂਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aabaadaan sadaa masahoor ||
lines.translation: That city is populous and eternally famous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਹਾਂ ਗਨੀ ਬਸਹਿ ਮਾਮੂਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: oohaa(n) ganee basahi maamoor ||2||
lines.translation: Those who live there are wealthy and contented. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੈਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tiu tiu sail karahi jiu bhaavai ||
lines.translation: They stroll about freely, just as they please.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਰਮ ਮਹਲ ਨ ਕੋ ਅਟਕਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maharam mahal na ko atakaavai ||
lines.translation: They know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and no one blocks their way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਖਲਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas khalaas chamaaraa ||
lines.translation: Says Ravi Daas, the emancipated shoe-maker:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਮ ਸਹਰੀ ਸੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo ham saharee s meet hamaaraa ||3||2||
lines.translation: whoever is a citizen there, is a friend of mine. ||3||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan ravidaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, Ravi Daas Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਅਵਘਟ ਡੂਗਰ ਘਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਹਮਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat avaghat doogar ghanaa ik niragun bail hamaar ||
lines.translation: The path to God is very treacherous and mountainous, and all I have is this worthless ox.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਮਈਏ ਸਿਉ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ramaeee siu ik benatee meree poo(n)jee raakh muraar ||1||
lines.translation: I offer this one prayer to the Lord, to preserve my capital. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਟਾਂਡਾ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ko banajaaro raam ko meraa taa(n)daa laadiaa jaai re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Is there any merchant of the Lord to join me? My cargo is loaded, and now I am leaving. ||1||Pause||
